basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 28-year-old financial analyst based in Chicago. I have a keen interest in personal finance and enjoy helping others make smarter financial decisions. Outside of work, I love playing Mario Kart with friends and have a soft spot for Brazilian football, especially Corinthians. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy exploring new hobbies, such as watching niche TV shows and listening to humorous podcasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Finance from the University of Illinois and have been working in the financial sector for over 5 years. My expertise in personal finance is both from formal education and a passion for staying updated on financial news and trends. I also enjoy self-teaching through online courses and finance-related books.
